Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUSB CRS Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the CRS Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. in Physics with a minimum of 55% marks. For the Junior II position, a valid JEST/GATE/NET-JRF/Lectureship/UGC-CSIR NET JRF/Lectureship is also required.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the CRS Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the CRS Project Fellow (Junior) position at the Central University of South Bihar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their completed application form, CV, and supporting documents via email to [email protected] with a specific subject line.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the CRS Project Fellow posts?
faq.answer: For Junior I, the fellowship amount is ₹14,000 pm + HRA @ 10%. For Junior II, it is ₹31,000 pm + HRA @ 10%.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the CRS Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial application review followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.answer: The Central University of South Bihar is located in Gaya, Bihar, with the pincode 824236.
